tagline: One unread inbox across all your Gmail accounts, with an AI that learns your keep/delete/unsubscribe decisions and queues deletions for you to approve.
summary: My Gmail Manager connects several Gmail accounts with Google OAuth and syncs their unread mail into one inbox. You review emails one at a time: Claude suggests **delete**, **keep** or **unsubscribe** using how you've treated similar mail from the same sender, and nothing is deleted or unsubscribed until you confirm. Your decisions, notes and declined unsubscribes become the precedent for next time.

It also runs unattended. Local Scheduler calls job endpoints on weekday mornings: sync unread mail, work through an AI process queue one message at a time (so rate limits and cost stay predictable), produce an inbox briefing once the queue is empty, and fill a deletion queue that you approve on the dashboard before messages are moved to Gmail Trash. Data can live locally or on the studio behind a storage server.
audience: You juggle several Gmail accounts (personal, work, side projects) and want one place to triage them.
Your inboxes fill with newsletters and notifications you mean to clean up but never do.
You want AI help that asks before deleting anything.
notFor: Writing or sending email — it reads, judges, labels, unsubscribes and trashes.
Fully automatic deletion — every deletion needs your approval on the dashboard.

capabilities.title: Connected accounts
capabilities.detail: `/connected-accounts` adds Gmail accounts via Google OAuth (`/api/gmail/oauth/start` → `/oauth-callback-page`). Tokens are encrypted at rest.

capabilities.title: Unified inbox
capabilities.detail: `/inbox` lists unread mail across accounts after **Sync** (`POST /api/gmail/sync-unread`).

capabilities.title: Email review with AI judgment
capabilities.detail: `/email-detail-page`: **Decide** asks Claude with same-sender history; you confirm delete, keep or unsubscribe and can add notes and labels.

capabilities.title: Unsubscribe with memory
capabilities.detail: Unsubscribe from a list, or record that you declined so future suggestions respect it.

capabilities.title: Inbox briefing
capabilities.detail: A label-keyed summary of past decisions, suggestions for the five newest emails, and an overall summary — changes nothing by itself.

capabilities.title: Dashboard queues
capabilities.detail: `/dashboard` shows inbox and accounts, the AI process queue, TO DO items needing direction and the deletion queue to approve or reject.

capabilities.title: Scheduled jobs
capabilities.detail: `POST /api/gmail/jobs/morning-inbox` and `/jobs/process-ai-queue`, called by Local Scheduler with `GMAIL_MANAGER_CRON_SECRET`.

capabilities.title: AI costs
capabilities.detail: `/ai-costs` lists every judgment, briefing and decision-profile exchange with estimated cost.

capabilities.title: Public pages
capabilities.detail: Landing, privacy policy and terms of service (needed for Google OAuth verification).

components.name: Web app
components.owns: Landing, legal pages, dashboard, inbox, email review, accounts, AI costs. Calls the API at `NEXT_PUBLIC_EXPRESS_URL` with `x-api-key`.

components.name: API
components.owns: Google OAuth, Gmail API calls (sync, labels, unsubscribe, trash), AI judgment/briefing/queues, cron job routes. Uses Postgres directly (`STORAGE_MODE=local`) or storage HTTP (`remote`).

components.name: Storage server
components.owns: `gmail_manager` Postgres (accounts, messages, labels, queues, ledgers, sync state), invoke + worker-credentials routes, `dispatcher_exposed_endpoints`.

dataFlow: You connect an account: Google OAuth redirects to the API's `GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI`; refresh/access tokens are encrypted with `TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY` and stored.
Sync pulls unread messages from the Gmail API into `gmail_messages`.
Decide sends one email plus same-sender decided history to Claude and logs request/response/exchange rows.
Morning job: sync → seed the AI process queue → the queue worker recommends deletions one message at a time → briefing when empty.
You approve deletion-queue rows on the dashboard; a job moves them to Gmail Trash.
In remote mode, all CRUD goes to storage via `STORAGE_EXPRESS_URL` (studio gateway `…:3010/my-gmail-manager` with `DISPATCHER_GATE_SECRET`, or direct with `STORAGE_EXPRESS_SECRET`).

trust.title: Browser
trust.detail: API URL and `NEXT_PUBLIC_GMAIL_MANAGER_API_KEY` (a local guard, visible to anyone with the page).

trust.title: API
trust.detail: Google client secret, `TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, cron secret, storage/gateway secret. Never returns tokens in JSON.

trust.title: Storage host
trust.detail: `DATABASE_URL` and the encryption key (to hand worker credentials to the API).

trust.title: Google / Anthropic
trust.detail: Gmail access is limited to the scopes you grant; email content goes to Anthropic when judged.

commonTasks.title: First-time setup (one machine)
steps: On the **Storage Express** repo, **Set up local database** (`gmail_manager`, `migrations/setup.sql` then numbered files).
Create a Google Cloud OAuth client with the Gmail API enabled; set `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` and `GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:<api-port>/api/gmail/oauth/callback`.
On the web set `NEXT_PUBLIC_EXPRESS_URL` and the same API key, then **Run** and connect accounts.

commonTasks.title: Two-device setup (studio storage)
commonTasks.when: Data on the studio, UI and API on a laptop.
steps: Pick the **remote** data plane on the API and point `STORAGE_EXPRESS_URL` at the studio gateway with `DISPATCHER_GATE_SECRET`.

commonTasks.title: Triage your inbox
steps: Sync on `/inbox`, open an email, click **Decide**.
Confirm or override; add a note so future decisions on that sender are better.
Approve or reject pending deletions on `/dashboard`.

commonTasks.title: Automate mornings
steps: Set the same `GMAIL_MANAGER_CRON_SECRET` on this API and in Local Scheduler.
Enable the `gmail-manager-*` tasks in Local Scheduler (morning inbox, process AI queue, briefing, deletions).

troubleshooting.fix: `GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI` must exactly match the Google Cloud console entry, including host and port.

troubleshooting.symptom: After OAuth you land on the wrong origin or see CORS errors
troubleshooting.fix: `WEB_APP_ORIGIN` must match how you open the web (localhost vs 127.0.0.1 are different origins).
`NEXT_PUBLIC_GMAIL_MANAGER_API_KEY` on the web doesn't match `GMAIL_MANAGER_API_KEY` on the API.
Local Scheduler's `GMAIL_MANAGER_CRON_SECRET` differs from the API's.

troubleshooting.symptom: Decide skips a message as needing direction
troubleshooting.fix: No precedent for that sender. Add a note or decide a few messages from the sender manually first.
Studio storage or gateway is down; check `<gateway>/my-gmail-manager/api/storage/health` or raise `STORAGE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS`.

glossary.definition: AI judgment on one email (delete / keep / unsubscribe) using same-sender history.
Serial queue of messages awaiting deletion recommendations.
AI-recommended deletions waiting for your approval.
A message with no precedent for its sender; the AI won't guess.
Read-only summary of decisions and suggestions for the newest mail.

hubNotes: Port mismatch: the API `.env.example` uses `PORT=3009` and an OAuth redirect on 3009, but the registry and web default expect 3052. The redirect URI must follow the real port.
Local Scheduler's seeded tasks target this API on port 3052.
Web and API READMEs are templates; read `DEPLOYMENT.md`, `TWO-DEVICE-DEPLOYMENT.md` and the ADRs.
